fields.overview: Which overview cards the node shows: dataset_snapshot, data_quality, numeric_summary, categorical_summary, schema, each true or false.
fields.pivots: Pivot tables over the input; each is a complete version-1 pivot: version 1, a unique id and name, enabled, and lists of filters, columns, rows and values placements, formula ids, value_order and options.
fields.pivots[].rows[] / columns[]: Placements {id, field, number_format, decimal_places, use_grouping}; a row placement also has sort "ascending" or "descending".
fields.pivots[].values[]: Aggregations {id, field, aggregation (sum, count, average, min, max, median, distinct_count), reference (always <field>_<aggregation>, such as premium_sum), display_name, sort_rows, color_scale, color_scale_split_by, number_format, decimal_places, use_grouping}.
fields.pivots[].value_order: The ids of the pivot's values and formulas in display order.
fields.steps: Optional step cards that shape the frame before it is explored; df is already the input. A pivot table the analyst asks for is a pivots entry, never a step. An Explore node has no output and ends its branch.

configs.name: minimal
configs.intent: Show the overview cards for the priced policies.

configs.name: realistic
configs.intent: Pivot total premium and policy count by region.
